cc:Work.dc:description: Test PoC, functional measurements. Bounty V2 audit and settlement rules. Thirty paired observations per configuration. Bars show means and error bars show sample standard deviations, not confidence intervals. Component times include context and process/storage overhead but exclude certification, chain waits and decryption. They do not measure total workflow latency.
